data.title: Projektingenieur Maschinenbau (m/w/d) - Technische Projektabwicklung
data.description:
Sie verbinden technisches Verständnis mit Organisationstalent und möchten anspruchsvolle Projekte von der Anfrage bis zur Fertigstellung begleiten?

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Projektingenieur Maschinenbau (m/w/d), der unsere Projektverantwortlichen bei der Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanfragen, Ausschreibungen und laufender Projekte unterstützt.

Im Mittelpunkt der Position stehen die Prüfung technischer Anforderungen, die Bewertung von Machbarkeiten sowie die Koordination und Begleitung der Projektumsetzung. Sie arbeiten dabei eng mit unseren Kunden, Lieferanten, der Konstruktion und der Fertigung zusammen.

Aufgaben

  • Prüfung und Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanfragen und Ausschreibungen
  • Analyse von Kundenanforderungen, Spezifikationen, technischen Zeichnungen und 3D-CAD-Daten
  • Bewertung der technischen und wirtschaftlichen Machbarkeit
  • Ermittlung von Material-, Fertigungs- und Arbeitsaufwänden
  • Mitwirkung bei Kalkulationen und der Erstellung von Angeboten
  • Unterstützung der Projektverantwortlichen bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Projekten
  • Koordination von Terminen, Aufgaben, Schnittstellen und offenen Punkten
  • Abstimmung mit Kunden, Lieferanten sowie internen Fachabteilungen
  • Begleitung der Projekte von der Anfrage über die Umsetzung bis zur Fertigstellung beziehungsweise Abnahme
  • Überwachung von Projektfortschritten und vereinbarten Terminen
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Projektunterlagen, Dokumentationen und Statusübersichten
  • Bearbeitung überwiegend englischsprachiger Ausschreibungs- und Projektunterlagen

Ihr Arbeitsumfeld

Sie begleiten kundenspezifische Maschinenbauprojekte sowie Sonderkonstruktionen, beispielsweise Transport-, Montage- und Fertigungsvorrichtungen für industrielle Anwendungen.

Dabei übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Kunden, Projektverantwortlichen, Konstruktion, Einkauf, Fertigung, Qualität und Lieferanten. Der Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit liegt auf der technischen und organisatorischen Projektabwicklung – nicht auf der Erstellung von CAD-Zeichnungen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium, beispielsweise im Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder in einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Alternativ eine Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker oder Meister mit passender Berufserfahrung
  • Berufserfahrung in der technischen Projektabwicklung, im Projektmanagement, Maschinenbau, Anlagenbau, Vorrichtungsbau oder in einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld
  • Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und 3D-CAD-Darstellungen sicher zu lesen, zu verstehen und hinsichtlich ihrer Umsetzbarkeit zu beurteilen
  • Eigene Konstruktionserfahrung oder die sichere Anwendung eines bestimmten CAD-Programms ist nicht erforderlich
  • Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung technischer Anforderungen, Ausschreibungen, Kalkulationen oder Angebote ist von Vorteil
  • Technisches Verständnis für Fertigungsprozesse, Materialien und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
  • Sichere Deutschkenntnisse für die interne Abstimmung und Dokumentation
  • Gute bis sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, insbesondere zum Verständnis und zur Bearbeitung technischer Ausschreibungen und Projektunterlagen

Benefits

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle
  • Eine geregelte 40-Stunden-Woche
  • Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Projekte in einem technisch spezialisierten Bereich der Luftfahrt
  • Ein Jahresbruttogehalt von 60.000 bis 75.000 Euro, abhängig von Ihrer Qualifikation, Berufserfahrung und Ihren relevanten Fachkenntnissen.
  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schnittstellenfunktion mit Einblick in sämtliche Projektphasen
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektverantwortlichen, Werkstatt und weiteren Fachbereichen
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Jobrad
  • Kostenfreie Parkplätze direkt am Unternehmen
  • Einen langfristig ausgerichteten Arbeitsplatz in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen

Die Relais-Control GmbH & Co. KG ist ein technisch vielseitiges Unternehmen mit den Geschäftsbereichen Armaturenreparatur, Maschinenbau und Luftfahrttechnik. An unserem Standort in Stade entwickeln und realisieren wir individuelle technische Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte.

Dabei verbinden wir Projektplanung, technische Abstimmung, Fertigung und praktische Umsetzung unter einem Dach. So erleben Sie unmittelbar, wie aus einer Kundenanfrage eine fertige technische Lösung entsteht.

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihres möglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen vollständig erfüllen, aber über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und passende Erfahrung in der Projektabwicklung verfügen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

  • Paid Ads skalieren: Du verantwortest Meta- und LinkedIn-Kampagnen mit 6-stelligen Budgets — nicht optimieren für Klicks, sondern für Conversions und ROAS.
  • Conversion Rate meistern: Du optimierst Landing Pages, Funnels und HubSpot-Workflows. Jede Seite, jeder Touchpoint ist ein A/B-Test. Du bringst die Conversion-Rate nach oben, nicht nur Traffic.

  • Zahlen sind dein Kompass: Aufbau und Eigentum von Tracking, Attribution und Reporting (GA4, GTM, HubSpot). Du misst alles, kennst deine CAC/ROAS/CPA und optimierst danach.
  • Automatisieren & Scale: CRM-Workflows (HubSpot), Automation (Make), Email-Sequenzen
  • Bottlenecks beheben: Du findest, warum Leads nicht konvertieren, und fixst es.
  • Mittelfristig: Du baust dir ein kleines Performance-Team auf.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast schon Growth-Experimente gefahren, die echt was bewegt haben – idealerweise im Start-up-/Scale-up-Umfeld
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Performance Marketing und/oder Growth über mehrere Kanäle (Google Ads, SEO, LinkedIn etc.)

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Automatisierungs-Tools (Make, Zapier o.ä.)

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit CRM (HubSpot) und Automatisierung (Make, Zapier o. Ä.)

Benefits

  • Ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Möglichkeit, im Home Office zu arbeiten
  • Ein attraktives Gehalt mit Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und entsprechenden Aufstiegschancen
  • Geregelte Arbeitszeiten
  • Unterstützung durch ein erfahrenes Team

Du erkennst dich nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt wieder? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Studien zeigen, dass sich insbesondere Frauen und unterrepräsentierte Gruppen oft nur dann bewerben, wenn sie 100 % der Anforderungen erfüllen. Bei uns zählt nicht der perfekte Lebenslauf, sondern deine Persönlichkeit und dein Wille, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Financial Control Team 👋

Trainline is Europe's leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our Financial Control team sits at the heart of how we understand and run the business, owning the quality and integrity of our management accounts, balance sheet and month end processes. As Head of Management Accounts, you'll lead a team through two Senior Finance Managers, covering the P&L from Revenue to Adjusted EBITDA (one above Gross Margin, one below), acting as the go-to expert for complex accounting judgement and the person who joins the dots across Financial Control, FP&A and the wider business.

You'll scale through your team rather than through the detail, empowering them to own the underlying processes end to end while you remain accountable for outcomes and standards, acting as the escalation point for judgement calls and the driver of improvement and projects. Beyond Financial Control, you'll be a natural point of contact for cross-functional work, partnering with teams including Legal, Commercial, Product and Technology to translate complex or ambiguous problems into a clear, well documented plan. Reporting into the Group Financial Controller, you'll build broad enough knowledge across external reporting, governance, working capital and FP&A to deputise when needed, and you'll represent Financial Control with authority across the business.

In this role as the Head of Management Accounts, you will...🚄

  • Lead the team within Financial Control, principally through two direct reports, acting as a role model who coaches and mentors to build capability, delegates effectively, holds the team to a high standard of delivery and keeps development and succession front of mind

  • Act as a thought leader within the team, bringing structure and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems and documenting conclusions so they can be applied consistently across the function

  • Lead cross-functional projects from beginning to end, working with teams including Legal, Commercial, Product and Technology, setting and holding a timeline and navigating senior stakeholder relationships to land a single, well-documented position

  • Hold accountability for the smooth, timely running of month end, including balance sheet integrity, key reconciliations and working capital analysis, with the team owning execution and you providing judgement and sign off, critically reviewing management accounts output for risks, inconsistencies and control gaps and ensuring a consistently high-quality, on-time, audit-ready close

  • Act as the subject matter expert for external reporting and controls, providing technical challenge on Annual Report and Half-Year Report verification activity, owning accounting policy judgements and their documentation, and liaising with external auditors on balance sheet and reporting matters as needed

  • Be accountable for a strong internal control environment, and drive continuous improvement and automation to reduce manual effort and improve the quality of outputs

  • Hold the team accountable for effective Order-to-Cash processes across the group, maintaining strong control and discipline, while proactively identifying emerging risks or areas of complexity

  • Own the cost budgeting process in partnership with FP&A, ensuring cost centre owners work to a clear timetable, challenge assumptions and are well prepared to present to the CFO, and build a team that acts as trusted finance partners across the business, providing insight and challenge that shapes commercial decisions, stepping in personally for the most complex or senior conversations

  • Maintain strong awareness of corporate governance as a listed business, provide senior oversight of working capital performance including Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, and deputise for the Group Financial Controller as required, including representing Financial Control at key forums

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Qualified accountant status (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with significant post-qualification experience running month end, balance sheet, reconciliation and working capital processes in a complex business

  • Experience managing and developing senior finance managers or teams, including setting direction and managing performance through others, with a track record of holding teams to high standards

  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and listed-company governance, and confidence making accounting policy judgements

  • A strong track record of business partnering with senior, non-finance stakeholders to shape commercial decisions

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust quickly, manage upwards, delegate effectively and run a project from beginning to end

  • A collaborative leadership style that empowers teams to own delivery, while you stay accountable for standards and outcomes

  • Experience of ERP platforms or finance automation tools

  • Experience in a listed or multi-currency business would be an advantage, though not essential

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

data.title: Senior Manager
data.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human-centered AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting-edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on-site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK.

When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK.

About the role

As a Senior Manager within our Defence team, you’ll lead critical work for discerning and highly AI-literate customers across the UK Defence landscape and for our international partners. This is a fast-paced and demanding role that requires deep mission-area context, programme delivery mastery, and the ability to think creatively about the role of AI in national security.

You can expect to lead high-stakes portfolios of work, ranging from the experimental application of emerging technologies to robust products that we progress through a complete development lifecycle and deploy for users in frontline commands.

What you'll be doing:

  • Managing the delivery of multiple, complex programmes of work for our Defence clients, spanning strategy, R&D, and bespoke product builds.

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of projects across multiple facets of the Defence enterprise, ensuring alignment with departmental strategic objectives.

  • Developing and owning compelling, mission-focused proposals to grow our Defence and National Security portfolio.

  • Mentoring and developing team members, aligning their growth with the critically important and sensitive work for which we’re responsible.

  • Working strategically to deliver meaningful operational outcomes and improved decision-making for Defence organisations rather than just focusing on outputs.

  • Forming strong, trusted relationships with senior military and civilian customers, collaborating closely with other industry partners where required.

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, engaging confidently in complex technical discussions with senior leaders and directors.

  • Supporting wider business efforts as a Senior Manager to ensure maximum strategic flexibility and commercial impact across the business unit.

Who we're looking for:

  • You are an experienced Senior Manager with a proven background in managing complex, large-scale transformation programmes within demanding environments.

  • You bring significant experience in the Defence space, possibly gained through a career in the Armed Forces, Government, academia, or industry roles.

  • You have a track record of shipping digital products and possess the expertise required to get AI-enabled services over the line within a Government or Defence context.

  • You demonstrate a deep interest in AI and ML concepts and can think creatively about their application to solve a range of modern battle-space and organisational challenges.

  • You possess the technical nous to engage confidently with senior stakeholders on engineering concepts and the practicalities of deploying AI at scale.

  • You understand the commercial consulting delivery model, allowing you to focus immediately on account growth, project oversight, and value creation.

  • You embrace an entrepreneurial approach to a highly visible portfolio, with the flexibility to support broader strategic work across the Senior Management team.

  • You thrive in ambiguous, high-stakes settings and maintain a structured approach to problem-solving and delivering high-quality results under pressure.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

data.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
data.description:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit within the Shopping team, reporting to the Lead Product Manager. The Shopping team turns travel supply into accurate, commercially optimised, bookable and payable holidays. It provides shared data and services that help customers, teams and partners make better selling decisions.

On the payments side, you’ll work closely with Engineering and Commercial Payments to own product strategy and delivery for the Payments platform. Together, the team will make it easier for other teams to offer, operate and improve payments without rebuilding the same logic in each customer journey. You will:

  • Build a flexible international payments platform: Define the shared services, data and APIs that meet local customer and market needs, while allowing payment methods to be launched and managed consistently across markets and customer journeys

  • Create reliable foundations: Improve the payment data, provider integrations and fraud controls that keep payments secure, dependable and easier to manage

  • Make payment methods easier to launch: Help teams configure, test and release supported methods safely, with less engineering work and clearer ownership

  • Enable payment optimisation at scale: Provide shared data and platform capabilities that help teams improve payment success and offer relevant payment methods across markets and journeys. Apply AI to improve insight and enable responsible automation where it delivers measurable value

Your day-to-day:

  • Working with your lead engineer and stakeholders to set the Payments vision, roadmap and success measures

  • Working with market experts, commercial teams and Customer Product teams to understand payment needs. Provide data to inform their decisions and translate agreed requirements into reusable platform capabilities

  • Exposing reliable payment data and provider insights so teams can understand failures, drop-off, acceptance rates and customer pain points. Work with those teams to prioritise the platform improvements needed to improve payment performance

  • Leading delivery: Lead work across payment services, provider integrations, payment data, configuration and fraud controls. Keep the platform straightforward for other teams to use

  • Working directly with payment providers and aggregators to solve issues, evaluate new capabilities and hold partners to the standards customers need

  • Explaining trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and building agreement on decisions that span several teams

Your skillset:

  • Platform product experience: You have owned a technical, API-led, data-rich or internal platform product that is used by more than one team or customer journey and involves a payments ecosystem

  • Systems thinking: You can understand how payment data, provider integrations, customer journeys, commercial rules and operational processes fit together, then turn that into reusable product capabilities

  • Technical fluency: You can work closely with engineers on APIs, integration patterns, data models, reliability, observability, security and migration work. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can make sound product trade-offs with them

  • Payments and commercial judgement: You understand the payment ecosystem and how method availability, payment success, fraud, cost and customer trust affect growth

  • Data-led problem solving: You are comfortable using data to investigate problems, define useful measures and judge whether a change is improving payment performance

  • Customer empathy: You understand that payments can be stressful, especially when people are making high-value holiday purchases or managing payments after booking. You use this to advocate for clear, dependable journeys

  • Strong delivery and communication: You can lead complex work through ambiguity, make priorities clear and bring technical, commercial and operational stakeholders with you. You deliver iteratively, focusing each step on meaningful value while keeping the team aligned to a clear long-term direction

  • AI literacy: You use AI tools confidently and can demonstrate their impact. You understand their strengths and limitations and can apply them responsibly to improve your work and payment capabilities

The interview journey:

  • Talent intro, 30 minutes

  • First stage with the hiring manager, 45 minutes

  • Final stage with key stakeholders, including a platform case to present, 1 hour

  • Behavioural and culture conversation with the Director of OTA Platform (Shopping’s pillar), 45 minutes

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

data.title: Data Scientist – Computational Genomics, 12-month FTC
data.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

This is a unique opportunity for a Data Scientist to bridge the gap between computational genomics and machine learning at scale. Operating at the genomics-ML interface, you will shape our computational genomics efforts to accelerate target identification and validation across diverse therapeutic areas, leveraging large-scale human genetics resources — genetic discovery, biobanks, OMICs, single-cell atlases and other internal datasets— to gain actionable insight. By building, refining and deploying cutting-edge ML-focussed methods you will inform robust functional prioritisation frameworks, mechanistic hypotheses, and strategic decision-making across the organisation.

Day to Day you will:

  • Apply, build, refine and integrate statistical models to gain insight from genomics, transcriptomics and other OMICs datasets and support target discovery and validation.

  • Work cross-functionally at the ML-genetics interface to identify opportunities, solve problems and implement solutions for shared insight

  • Integrate human genetics evidence with OMICs datasets (e.g. transcriptomics, proteomics) to uncover disease mechanisms and prioritise actionable targets.

  • Develop scalable computational workflows for reproducible analysis within Relation’s existing stack

  • Partner closely with experimental and machine learning researchers to validate hypotheses, interpret results, and guide downstream studies.

  • Communicate findings clearly to internal stakeholders, including presenting methods, results, and recommendations.

  • Contribute to publications, scientific communications, and project documentation, supporting scientific excellence and external visibility.

Professionally, you will have

  • PhD in statistical genetics, genomics, computational biology, machine learning, bioinformatics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to biological data

  • Experience in quantitative genomics, statistics, bioinformatics, or multi-omics data analysis.

  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), or R, and familiarity with high-performance computing environments, collaborative coding and version control (e.g. git)

  • Bonus experience:

    • Familiarity with single-cell transcriptomics or patient-derived datasets.

    • Experience working in interdisciplinary/matrixed teams within biotech or pharma settings.

    • Understanding of the end-to-end drug discovery process and how genetic evidence informs decision-making.

Personally, you:

Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together!

The patient is waiting!

RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

Relation is a committed equal opportunities employer.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the role:

We're looking for a Deal Strategy & Operations Lead to join our growing Deal Strategy & Operations team. In this role, you'll review and structure non-standard SaaS contracts, evaluate pricing requests, and collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Legal to expedite deal approvals.   • Detail-oriented, excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to identify areas of improvement and propose necessary changes

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment

  • You are skilled at prioritization, effectively balancing urgent support requests with long-term project work.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Developer Experience team builds the backend systems and product capabilities that help developers understand, secure and ship software with confidence. The team powers important parts of Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the workflows that turn supply-chain data into useful developer experiences.

Our systems are deliberately polyglot. Today that includes Clojure and Go services, event-driven workflows, Kafka, legacy Datomic components and newer Spanner-backed services. We will keep evolving the stack as the product and business change. We are looking for an adaptable backend engineer who can become effective in an unfamiliar codebase, choose technology pragmatically and help other engineers do the same. Clojure experience is useful, but it is not a requirement and this is not a Clojure-specialist role.

We make extensive use of AI-assisted engineering tools. We expect engineers to use them thoughtfully, validate their output and remain accountable for the quality, security and operability of what ships. At Staff level, you will also help the team turn good individual practice into repeatable workflows, controls and shared standards.

data.description:
LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.


With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

About the role

LemFi's Credit tribe is early and moving fast. We're building the infrastructure that will power lending products for millions of people who've historically been locked out of fair credit - immigrants, diaspora communities, and the financially underserved across our 21 operating markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity: the tribe is being built right now, and the systems you design today will be the foundation everything else sits on.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Credit tribe and own core backend services end-to-end. You'll be working primarily in Go, with some existing Java services in the mix - switching between them is not the blocker, deep engineering craft and an instinct for how credit products behave is. We move fast and we don't micromanage, which means you'll need to bring the domain awareness to make the right call before anyone has to tell you.

What you'll build and own

  • Design, build and operate high-reliability backend services that power LemFi's credit products, from loan origination and underwriting through to repayment and collections.

  • Make the right architectural calls independently - data residency, service boundaries, state-machine design for loan lifecycles - without needing to be told what a credit-safe system looks like.

data.title: Bid Manager
data.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

Most of the contracts we win in UK healthcare start life as a tender, as do a growing number of deals with private providers, social care organisations and national programmes. We’re looking for a Bid Manager to own that process across the UK and Ireland, from deciding which opportunities to chase to pressing submit.

You’ll work with Commercial, Medical Operations, Clinical Safety, Product, Security and Finance, and turn what we know into answers an evaluator can score. Your job is to help us win more of the right bids, and to build the process and content library that makes every bid after that faster.

What You Will Do

  • Own bids end to end: qualification, bid/no-bid decisions, planning, kick-off, drafting, review, compliance checks, submission and clarification questions.

  • Bid across the whole market: NHS trusts, ICBs and primary care, national frameworks, local authority social care, central government and devolved nations’ programmes, and private and independent sector providers.

  • Write and edit responses on clinical value, implementation, clinical safety, information governance, security, social value and pricing.

  • Work with subject matter experts (clinicians, clinical safety officers, engineers, security and finance) to get the right input on time, and turn complex technical and regulatory detail into clear, compliant answers.

  • Develop win themes and executive summaries that connect our evidence to what each buyer is actually scoring.

  • Track upcoming tenders, frameworks and dynamic markets, and help Commercial leadership decide where to spend our effort.

  • Keep the bid library current: standard answers, case studies, evidence, policies and certifications.

  • Run post-bid reviews, collect evaluator feedback and use it to lift our win rate.

  • Work with the delivery team to track the social value commitments we make once a contract is awarded.

  • Improve how we bid, including the AI tools and workflows we already use to draft and review answers.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Bid Manager or senior Bid Writer, with a track record of winning public sector healthcare or social care contracts.

  • Working knowledge of UK public procurement, including the Procurement Act 2023, the Provider Selection Regime, frameworks and dynamic markets.

  • Experience beyond the NHS, such as local authorities, central government, devolved administrations, or private and independent sector buyers.

  • Excellent writing. You can make a complex answer short, clear and compliant, and we’ll ask you to show us.

  • Strong project management. You can run several bids at once, hold people to deadlines and stay calm the night before a noon submission.

  • Confidence working with senior clinical, technical and commercial stakeholders, and challenging them when an answer isn’t good enough yet.

  • Commercial judgement about which bids are worth pursuing, and the confidence to recommend a no-bid.

  • Comfort in a fast-paced scale-up and genuine enthusiasm for using AI in your own work.

Bonus Points

  • Experience bidding for digital health, health tech or SaaS contracts.

  • Familiarity with NHS digital standards such as DTAC, DSPT, DCB0129 and DCB0160.

  • Experience with frameworks such as NHS SBS, Crown Commercial Service or regional NHS frameworks.

  • APMP accreditation or equivalent.

  • Experience bidding in Ireland or other European markets.

  • A clinical, social care or public sector commissioning background.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with Hiring Manager

  3. Bid writing task - a written response to a sample tender question, followed by a discussion with the Hiring Manager

  4. Working Day - Join us in the London office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & company stock options

  • 30 days/year of paid vacation

  • £800 wellness budget per year

  • Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

  • Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

  • Mental health support through our partner Mindler

  • Pension program

  • Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

  • An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

  • Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - RL Environments
data.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Role Overview:
Building AI agents that can assist with any kind of enterprise work is a challenging, open-ended problem. One key piece of solving it is replicating real work environments as realistically as possible - filling them with hard tasks to solve, creating plausible input data, and defining clear rewards for completing the work the right way. We build many of these reinforcement learning (RL) environments, then drop our agents into them to evaluate or train them.

In this role, you are responsible for creating these RL environments, running AI agents inside them, and improving both the agents and the environments in the process. The results reach customers, whose feedback feeds back in - and the agent/environment improvement loop continues.


Key Responsibilities:
There are many open problems in this space. As a Member of Technical Staff, RL Environments, you will:

  • Build new RL environments targeting different agentic capabilities and industry areas

  • Train and evaluate agents in those environments

  • Make all the pieces work together: tasks, data, tool implementations, and verifiers

  • Work across modeling and product to identify gaps in agent performance, and improve both the agents and the environments

  • Work with external vendors to create high-quality, expert-built RL environments, and build tools to ensure high task, data, and verifier quality

  • Automate the discovery of model capability gaps, and systematically measure agent performance during evals and training

Qualifications:

You may be a good fit if:

  • You have engineered agents and optimized them for specific industry use cases

  • You have spent dozens of hours reviewing agent trajectories to pinpoint exact failure points and fix them with model training or harness engineering

  • You obsess over measuring agentic capabilities and turning that into a repeatable process

  • You have had many debates about what a good outcome from an AI agent should look like, you translated that into verifier implementations and tuned the reward designs

  • You have designed and run annotation workflows to surface insights into agent performance and verify data quality

  • You have built synthetic data pipelines to scale eval and training efforts

  • You use agents yourself in your daily work, and have stories about how you improved your setup to 10x your productivity

  • A plus: you have experience with training with RL: scaling, troubleshooting and tuning the environments

If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

 

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

How and Where We Work:

If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Ledger Platform
data.description:
Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. We work closely with a Product Manager, shipping frequently and owning our systems in production. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Go beyond the code to develop deep expertise in our domain — our core financial products and our stakeholders' needs — and become a trusted technical advisor to the business.

  • Perform detailed technical scoping and prototyping to support feasibility testing and decision making.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code and foster a collaborative environment by reviewing work and writing useful documentation.

Learning and Growth:

  • Work with the team to improve our development and agile practices and raise our engineering standards.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Extensive back-end engineering experience.

  • Experience building and running microservices and distributed systems in production. Comfortable reasoning about durable cross-service communication, transactional correctness, and failure modes at scale.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • A strong technical or mathematical foundation, evidenced by a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Maths or similar) or equivalent professional experience.

  • You work well as a peer: pairing on hard problems, giving useful code review, and unblocking teammates day-to-day.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

  • A background in high-logic or high-scale fields like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare Tech, Logistics, Security/Cryptography or similar.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

  • Knowledge of messaging frameworks and event-driven patterns (e.g. Kafka).

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £110,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

We're looking for a backend engineer to join the Repeats team.

You will work on the services that decide which repeat customers get a loan, at what price, and how much they can borrow. These sit at the heart of iwoca's back book.

The company

Imagine a world where every small business has the power to thrive. That's the world we're building at iwoca. Small businesses aren't just statistics – they're the heartbeat of our communities, the character of our high streets, and the engine of our economy. Since 2012, we've revolutionised how these businesses access finance, turning what was once a lengthy, frustrating process into something remarkable: funding that's fast, flexible, and actually works for modern businesses.

Our impact speaks for itself: we've provided billions in funding to over 150,000 businesses across Europe, making us one of the continent's leading fintech innovators. But we're just getting started. Our mission? To empower one million businesses with the financial tools they deserve.

We combine cutting-edge technology and data science with genuine human understanding to make finance feel less like a barrier and more like a superpower. Whether it's managing cash flow or seizing unexpected opportunities, we ensure businesses get the funds they need – often within minutes.

The team

The Repeats team is one of iwoca's funnel teams. We grow customer lifetime value after a business's first loan. That means we own the underwriting, pricing, and product experience for two segments that make up most of iwoca's back-book value: top-up customers who borrow again while still repaying, and loan-ended customers who return for a new loan. Almost every repeat borrower goes through code we own. The team is cross-functional – backend, frontend, product, design, data science and analytics – shipping behind split tests and measuring impact in Looker rather than on gut feel.

The role

Your first project will be the re-architecture of our flex-loan repeat offer pipeline: the flow that decides who is eligible for a new loan, what they pay, and how much they can borrow. This area has been under-invested for years. Once the new pipeline is in place, product has a clear runway of features ready to ship on top of it.

  • You use AI (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow – whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour and high-stakes decisions.

data.title: Enterprise Account Manager - UKI
data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role:

As our Account Management team grows we are looking for a customer-oriented and result-driven Enterprise AM to join us.

As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

In this role you will be responsible for a portfolio of top accounts. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll-up your sleeves and work hard.


What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of Tier 1 customers, building trusted relationships with champions, key decision makers, and executive stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Travel, HR, IT, and Leadership.

  • Build and execute strategic account plans by developing a deep understanding of your customers' business, identifying expansion opportunities, mitigating risks, and maximising long-term customer value.

  • Identify growth opportunities across business units, geographies, and product lines to expand your portfolio through new business opportunities, upselling, and cross-selling.

  • Drive adoption across Perk's Travel and Spend platform by identifying underutilised features, expanding use cases, and partnering with customers on change management initiatives.

  • Leverage data and analytics to lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), delivering reports and presentations that demonstrate business outcomes, product adoption, ROI, and future strategic opportunities to senior stakeholders.

  • Be an expert across Perk's Travel and Spend platform to educate customers on new capabilities and consistently meet or exceed quarterly expansion targets.

  • Identify common challenges within each account, develop timely solutions, and implement long-term strategies that improve customer outcomes and satisfaction.

  • Be Perk's biggest advocate within your customers and your customers' biggest advocate within Perk by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Technical Support teams to resolve issues, influence product improvements, and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Effectively prioritise your time and resources to maximise impact across your portfolio and key business initiatives.


What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience managing a portfolio of Tier 1 customers in a SaaS, travel-tech, fintech, or spend management environment. Experience working with finance, procurement, travel, or expense management ecosystems is a strong plus.

  • Proven ability to build relationships across Finance, Procurement, Travel, HR, IT, and executive leadership within large enterprise organisations.

  • Experience navigating complex enterprise organisations with multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and executive decision-makers.

  • Outstanding presentation and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and build trusted, long-term relationships.

  • Strong financial, commercial, and analytical acumen, with the ability to discuss T&E policy, spend controls, ROI, cost optimisation, and operational efficiency with finance leaders.

  • Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and long-term customer value.

  • Excellent prioritisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across a portfolio of strategic accounts.

 

On top of that, you will only be the right candidate if you are:

  • Empathetic: someone who can identify with the customer and genuinely wants to support them using an optimal problem-solving methodology

  • Honest, open and trustworthy: your peers and managers can trust you. You are a team player, don’t play political games, and care more about the team’s success than about your own career gains

  • Focused and determined: You don’t let yourself be distracted. You can focus on accomplishing big wins and never get lost in less important ideas that are floating around

  • Growth Mindset: You seek feedback early and often and are open to both give and take constructive and direct criticism

  • Experience using inside sales tools like Salesforce, Google Tools, Zendesk, Looker.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

data.title: Team Lead, Account Development Representatives
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

What You'll Do:

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

What You'll Bring:

  • Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

  • A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

  • The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

  • Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

  • A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

  • Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

  • You touch the line. Your metrics back it up: leading indicators (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene) and lagging indicators (quota attainment, pipeline generated) that show a track record of real discipline, not one good quarter.

  • Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

  • Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

  • The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

  • Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

  • Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

  • Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.

We'll consider strong internal and external candidates. For external hires, the bar is high: we're looking for someone who brings something genuinely differentiated.

Culture and Values:

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

  • Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

  • Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

  • Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

  • Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

  • Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

  • Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline."

This role is a genuine development opportunity. For the right person, it's the foundation of a leadership career at Kong.

Interested? Reach out to Oscar Winberg to discuss.
