Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Company & Function Overview

Checkout.com is seeking a dedicated individual to join the Treasury New Products function within Group Treasury. This team sits at the critical intersection of product development, commercial strategy, and treasury risk management & execution. Acting as a strategic conduit between product/engineering teams and treasury subject matter experts (SMEs) across multiple disciplines, this team ensures new product initiatives globally—from greenfield launches to complex payment flows—are financially sound, scalable, and compliant.

As Checkout.com expands its ecosystem, this role will serve as the primary driver and subject-matter expert for digital assets related initiatives from a Treasury perspective. Over time, the role holder will also build a deep, end-to-end understanding of Checkout’s broader infrastructure and product stack, enabling holistic, cross-domain strategic thinking and long-term portfolio diversification.

Position Overview

In this role, you will be the gateway between Product and Treasury, translating innovative product ideas into methodologies, pragmatic design of processes and putting them into practices.

Global Crypto & Blockchain Initiative Leadership across two dimensions: You will act as the dedicated Treasury partner to enable Product-led crypto and digital asset initiatives, while also directly leading Treasury-driven digital asset native projects driving transformation and optimisation.

Holistic Checkout Infrastructure and Multi Product Mastery: While taking primary ownership of the digital asset roadmap, you will actively expand your expertise across Checkout’s core non-crypto infrastructure and product stack to ensure seamless integration with the fiat payments ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnering & Discovery: Work with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Commercial and Legal) to review and advise on crypto/ digital asset related product development opportunities from the Treasury standpoint, helping to shape the strategy and path for execution.

  • Single Point of Contact: Act as a primary point of contact for the Product teams, ensuring effective communication and coordination with relevant Treasury (SMEs). And vice versa.

  • Business Requirement Ownership: Assess impacts for Treasury, and synthesize requirements from Treasury SMEs across different disciplines and geographies—including those related to risk management, bank relations, data, system integration and operational processes—are translated into actionable, prioritised business requirements incorporated into new product development and optimisation efforts.

  • Digital Asset Native Treasury Leadership: Drive the digital assets native strategy and lead implementation to modernise the approach, infrastructure and tooling for Checkout’s Treasury management, working closely with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Operational Readiness: Ensure that capabilities, data flows, and risk controls are robustly built, and processes and procedures are stood up before products go live and scale in production.

  • Cross-domain excellence: Proactively develop all-round knowledge of Checkout’s infrastructure, product stack and flow of funds. Leverage this cross-domain insight to solve complex overlapping challenges between fiat and digital asset products, and contribute to broader New Products deliveries.

  • New Products governance: Support the documentation and implementation of operating models, frameworks and policies relevant to New Products, and alignment at the Enterprise level


Required Skills & Experience

  • Domain Expertise: Practical, hands-on experience operating with crypto wallets, or within the digital assets ecosystems (e.g., at a crypto-native firm, fintech innovator, or digital-asset banking unit).

  • Treasury or Product Management Background: Hands-on experience in Treasury/Finance change management OR Product Management with direct exposure to complex payment infrastructure, flow of funds, and cash management.

  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and engage effectively with different stakeholders.

  • Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking and analytical skills with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

  • Communications: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly.

  • Details & Velocity: Excellent attention to detail and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in new product assessments, project management, or business advisory roles.

  • An understanding of complex payment and flow of funds.

  • Familiarity with financial resource management or cash management practices.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

  • Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

  • Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

  • Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

  • Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

  • Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

  • Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

  • React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

  • A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

  • Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

  • A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

  • A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

data.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
data.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

data.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
data.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

data.title: Senior IC PDK Development Engineer
data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing start-up based in London. We are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 


Functions of the Role

The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.

  • Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
  • Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
  • Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
  • Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
  • Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.


Experience - Essentials

  • Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
  • Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
  • Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
  • Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
  • Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
  • General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location (Islington)


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment, or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

data.title: 2D Graphic/Product Designer (Softlines & Kids Accessories) (all genders)
data.description:
About tonies:

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.


With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval.

This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you.


This role may NOT be a great fit if:
  • Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design.
  • Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware).   
  • You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences.   
  • Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Design ownership across the full PDP

  • Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more.
  • Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process
  • Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards
  • Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off
  • Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand
Licensor management
  • Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships
  • Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule
  • Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range
Brand stewardship
  • Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories
  • Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem
  • Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue)
  • Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity 
Cross-functional collaboration
  • Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction
  • Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination
  • Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. 


What we are looking for:

  • 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential
  • Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories
  • Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP)
  • Experience working with ODM/OEM supply chains — you know what a design brief needs to include for a manufacturer to execute it
  • Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar)
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Suite proficiency (Illustrator, Photoshop) including production-ready artwork
  • Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why
  • English at a professional level; German is a strong plus
  • You must be able to work hybrid from one of our offices: Dusseldorf, Berlin, Schwäbisch Gmünd or London.

Nice to have:
  • 3D rendering capability (Keyshot, Rhino, or similar)
  • Experience designing within licensed brand style guides (entertainment IP, or similar)
  • Background in apparel, fashion & home accessories, or soft goods design (toys & consumer electronics is a plus)
  • Understanding of sustainable packaging and materials principles
  • Portfolio that demonstrates physical product development, not just graphic design


Why tonies?

●   Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.
●   Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.
●   Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.
●   Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.
●   Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.
●   Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!
●   Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.


Good to know:

Please submit your application documents in English.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role:

As a Senior TPM of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners.

  • Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives.

  • Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones.

  • High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision.

  • End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market.

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

data.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

 

About the Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

  • Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

  • Design and drive AI Agent adoption roadmaps for each customer, sequencing automation rollout to support change management and prove value at each stage.

  • Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration.

  • Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms.

  • Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and cross-functional accountability throughout the onboarding process.

  • Manage integrations with the customer's ecommerce tech stack; explore feasibility of custom integration paths and troubleshoot proactively using available technical resources and AI tools.

  • Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting and workback schedules, ensuring effective project management throughout the implementation.

  • Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers.

  • Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI Agent, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly. Proactively uses tools like Claude to improve your own efficiency.

  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

  • Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn.

  • Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge.

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.
  • Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies.
  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.

Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.

Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments.
  • Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).

 


Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.

Nous recrutons un gestionnaire service facturier à l’Agence comptable.

Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le traitement et le paiement des dépenses de l’UTC, depuis la réception des factures jusqu’à leur mise en paiement.

Vous aurez la possibilité :

. d'exercer vos compétences dans un environnement agréable et stimulant, au service de la communauté universitaire (étudiants, chercheurs, enseignants-chercheurs…)

. de rejoindre une équipe accueillante, dynamique et expérimentée

. de bénéficier de conditions de travail permettant un bon équilibre vie professionnelle - vie personnelle.

Votre mission

Vous assurez la réception, le contrôle, la comptabilisation et le paiement de tout type de dépense : factures, marchés publics, bourses, missions, gratification des stagiaires. Vous contribuez activement aux opérations de la chaîne de dépense.

Vos activités

  • Vous assurez la réception, la gestion et la dématérialisation des factures (espace numérique de travail, portail Chorus Pro).

  • Vous procédez à la fiabilisation et à la mise en qualité des données comptables.

  • Vous vérifiez la réalisation du service fait et l’apurement des opérations en attente.

  • Vous contrôlez les pièces justificatives (factures, ordres de mission, bourses notamment) et leur validité.

  • Vous liquidez les factures et procédez au paiement.

 

Vous participez également à des opérations courantes du service comme la gestion des bourses.

Vous êtes amené à suivre l’exécution de marchés publics, de contrats de maintenance ou de conventions et à renseigner les tableaux de suivi. Vous identifiez les anomalies, les rejets ou les pièces manquantes et vous assurez leur régularisation avec les interlocuteurs concernés. 

Une partie importante de votre activité repose sur la relation avec les gestionnaires des départements, des laboratoires et des services. Vous assurez les relances, suivez les demandes en cours et contribuez à l’apurement des opérations, si nécessaire. 

Vous suivez avec une attention particulière le délai global de paiement des centres financiers qui vous sont rattachés.

Vous intervenez également sur une période spécifique comme la fin d’exercice.

  

Nous recherchons un profil avec une expérience en comptabilité, à l’aise avec l’analyse de données comptables et financières courantes, appréciant les activités nécessitant méthode, précision et respect des procédures.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 4 personnes, le service facturier au sein de l’Agence comptable.

Placé sous l’autorité de l’agent comptable, vous rendrez compte à la responsable du service facturier, particulièrement sur les dossiers nécessitant une intervention ou un arbitrage.

Vous serez en contact avec de nombreux interlocuteurs : les membres de l’équipe du service facturier et de l’agence comptable, les chargés d’affaires de la direction des affaires financières, les gestionnaires des différents services de l’UTC, les partenaires et usagers (fournisseurs, organismes, étudiants, stagiaires).

About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

 

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation.

 
 

The role

You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you.

Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you.

 

What you'll do

 

Own French payroll

  • Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks

  • Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations)

  • Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium

  • Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis

  • Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise

  • Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships

  • Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes

 

Run the employee lifecycle

  • Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data

  • Keep Workday data accurate and compliant

  • Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects

  • You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP.

 

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it

  • Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar)

  • Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased

  • A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better

  • Comfort working in English in a multicultural team

  • Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope

 

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

 

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

 

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Why join us ?

  • Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production.

data.title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
data.description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region
  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
  • Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences
  • Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon

    • Life at Scality
  • We offer careers with an opportunity to bridge international borders, an intensely fun environment with smart people.
  • We encourage promotion and elevation through training and development programs.
  • We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages.
  • We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world.
  • Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer!
